messages:
alex: Evening handoff from me. Primary=alex, Secondary=@priya until 02:00 UTC. Current: reranker incident active but customer impact is limited — summary below.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT created: reranker-latency-regression (sev2) — pages sent to @eng-oncall at 1976543150. Monitoring thread: https://incidents.redwood/r/reranker-latency-regression

priya: quick status check — are we seeing 5xx or just higher p95?

alex: Mostly p95 latency up ~2.1x for na-rerank prefix workload. No 5xx spikes. Observed steady memory growth in candidate-filter after last canary deploy.

joel: Pushed temporary scaling to add +2 replicas to the canary pool and increased pod concurrency limit. Queue depth dropped ~30% in the last 8m. Mem growth still trending though.

priya: can you paste the runbook id for memory escalations?

alex: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/reranker-memory-escalation (internal). Steps taken: drained canaries -> redeploy with 12h mem limit -> monitor 10m. Logs command we used: ```kubectl -n prod logs deploy/candidate-filter -c main --since=10m | tail -n 40```

maria: CS note: two customers reported latency spikes affecting payment flows. Ticket CS-4592 opened, engineers looped in.

sam: Added a temporary alert to infra/reranker/memory-heatmap at 80% baseline. Primary should watch that dashboard for the next 60m.

alex: @joel keep scaling policy for at least 1h. If mem growth doesn't stabilize escalate to platform-eng. @priya you'll take primary at 02:00 UTC unless anything changes.

priya: Acknowledged. I'll tail the logs every 15m and be ready to rollback canary tag to v1.18 if p95 doesn't improve in 40m.

incident-bot: Pager cleared at 1976544500 — status: mitigation holding. Incident moved to monitoring. Postmortem owner assigned: joel.

alex: Night team next steps: 1) keep scaling policy active, 2) ensure CS-4592 has customer updates, 3) if memory >70% on any canary run heap-dump and contact joel. Add repro notes to #eng-ml.

priya: I'll update the handoff doc with these steps: https://docs.redwood/handovers/1976543210 (internal). Taking over at 02:00 UTC. No other active pagers from my side.

alex: :thumbsup: Good handoff. I'm available for 30m if anything urgent comes up.
